findings.highlight: With a wound this big, it'll never stop...!
findings.evidenceJa: 肘の先からまるごと、バケツめいた孔
findings.governingReading: The source explicitly describes the entire portion of the left arm beyond the elbow as a bucket-like opening.
findings.explanation: The Japanese specifies the extent and shape of the damage beyond Shirou’s elbow. “A wound this big” leaves those concrete features unspecified.
